cmu_dog.citation: Zhou, Y., Kang, Y. and Black, A. W. (2018). A Dataset for Document Grounded Conversations. EMNLP 2018. Hinglish version distributed by CMU Festvox and used as the English-to-Hinglish machine translation task in GLUECoS (Khanuja et al., ACL 2020).
cmu_dog.role: Baseline reproduction surface. This is the GLUECoS English-to-Hinglish MT task: published numbers exist and the data is downloadable, with train/validation/test splits already fixed upstream. It replaces the MixMT Subtask-1 gate, whose test set was never released (the WMT22 task page still reads 'Test phase -- TBD').

hinge.citation: Srivastava, V. and Singh, M. (2021). HinGE: A Dataset for Generation and Evaluation of Code-Mixed Hinglish Text. Eval4NLP 2021, 200-208. https://aclanthology.org/2021.eval4nlp-1.20
hinge.role: Primary corpus. English / Devanagari Hindi / human Hinglish, plus WAC and PAC rule-based outputs with 1-10 quality ratings. Supplies the Devanagari slice requirement AI-6 names and the three-column structure the gold set was specified as.
hinge.note: docs/datasheet.md recorded this licence as 'Unstated; inherits IIT Bombay's terms at minimum / non-commercial (inferred) / unresolved'. The authors' own lab (Lingo Research Group, IIT Gandhinagar) publishes it as CC-BY-4.0. The datasheet is corrected accordingly.

phinc.citation: Srivastava, V. and Singh, M. (2020). PHINC: A Parallel Hinglish Social Media Code-Mixed Corpus for Machine Translation. WNUT 2020. https://aclanthology.org/2020.wnut-1.7 Original release: https://zenodo.org/record/3605597
phinc.role: Scale. 13,738 code-mixed Hinglish sentences with human-written English translations. Reversed, it is English-to-Hinglish training data. It is also the official MixMT Subtask-2 training set, so it shares the lineage this project already cites.

trilingual.citation: Mazumder, D., Pathak, D., Kodali, P. and Patro, J. (2026). Neither Here Nor There: Cross-Lingual Representation Dynamics of Code-Mixed Text in Multilingual Encoders. Findings of EMNLP 2026. https://arxiv.org/abs/2603.19771
trilingual.role: Second three-column source: 21,139 English / Devanagari Hindi / Romanised Hinglish triples.
trilingual.note: Its own documentation lists PHINC among its sources, so it overlaps the training corpus above. The section 3.5 leakage check must therefore run ACROSS datasets, not only across splits. A within-split check alone would report a clean result that is false.
trilingual.licence_warning: NC and SA. Non-commercial use only, and derivatives share alike. Keep any artefact derived from it separable from the CC-BY-4.0 work.

note: Hashes and licences for the raw corpora. The data itself is not committed (.gitignore excludes data/raw/); this manifest is what makes the fetch reproducible and auditable. Regenerate with scripts/fetch_data.py, re-check with --verify.
